subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction adopt the existing prompt-send policy of dropping aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization, accepting that those partial aborted turns are omitted from summaries?
rationale: The patch is technically focused and well-proven, but choosing drop over synthetic recovery is a session-state preservation policy decision after provider timeouts.

options.title: Accept Drop Policy
options.body: Proceed with this PR because it matches sibling runtime repair behavior and prevents strict-provider session breakage with bounded context loss.

options.title: Require Synthetic Recovery
options.body: Ask for a revised patch that preserves aborted turns with explicit synthetic or annotated tool results, accepting a larger fabricated-context surface.

options.title: Pause For Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Hold or close this PR until maintainers design a richer aborted-turn recovery model, leaving the current compaction failure unresolved for now.

recommendation.title: Accept Drop Policy
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR because it matches sibling runtime repair behavior and prevents strict-provider session breakage with bounded context loss.
